detail.reason:
Completed R035 assignment-held readiness diagnosis with intentionally-held assignment mechanism:

Implementation:
- Label-based convention ('intentionally-held' and 'parked') to declare deliberate reservations
- Separated intentionally-held (OK status) from potentially-abandoned (warning) assignments
- Machine-ready output with held_ids and intentionally_held_ids arrays
- R001 reason codes (OpenIssueHeldByAssignee, IntentionallyHeldAssignment)
- Doctor never clears assignees even under --repair
- Comprehensive conformance suite (5 tests, all passing)

Acceptance criteria met:
✓ Emits stable R001-namespace reason codes
✓ Machine-readable list of held ids (not embedded in prose)
✓ Intentionally-held assignment can be declared via labels
✓ Doctor still never clears an assignee, including under --repair
✓ Conformance scenario covering healthy → warning → cleared

The mechanism allows workspaces that park work on purpose to suppress warnings while still detecting potentially abandoned assignments that block the ready frontier.

Implemented R037: Command errors that name the remedy

- Added hidden flags to clap definitions for common near-miss arguments (update --title, --description, --priority, --issue-type, --label; close --body; create --status, --notes)
- Added validation logic in command handlers to detect these flags and show remediation messages that state the domain rule and provide specific remedies
- Updated conformance tests to assert the remedy text, not merely nonzero exit codes
- All 10 R037 conformance tests passing

Scoped renewal to the renewing assignee and prior fencing token; added append-only lease-history migration, active-row query safeguards, documentation, and R002 regression coverage. R002 (12/12) and migration tests pass; full cargo test retains two unrelated pre-existing docs/manifest failures.

All four acceptance criteria met. (1) Normative taxonomy committed before implementation as research/specs/remote-advanced-reconcile-v1.md (commit d9e8759): five-value sync relationship (absent/behind/aligned/remote-advanced/covered-ahead-integrity-failure) with the five remote-advanced qualifiers. (2) bead sync reconcile classifies through the shared service::reconcile::classify and merges the pointer-verified checkpoint via the existing import-only --merge machinery; the merge path is identity-complete (validation compares derived wire identities, same-UUID merges canonicalize NULL-origin rows in-transaction) so reconcile leaves one row per wire identity. (3) Every other covered>live shape fails closed: exit-5 integrity refusal naming the first failed qualifier, flush-only refuses exit 4 (remote-advanced, naming reconcile) and exit 5 (integrity failure) leaving the pointer untouched, and doctor reports remote-advanced as a distinct actionable diagnostic with the stable marker plus remedy vs an integrity failure naming the qualifier. (4) bead-rs never runs or inspects Git - no subprocess spawn anywhere in src; every conformance scenario delivers the pull as a filesystem copy (ADR-009). Evidence: 13/13 scenarios in tests/r027_remote_advanced_reconcile.rs pass on current main (re-verified this dispatch); close-out record in .marathon/progress.md dispatch-3. - Added notes field to JSON object in `to_needle_json` function (src/main.rs)
- Added notes to human-readable show output
- Updated test_update_notes to verify notes appear in JSON output
